guide.overview: Wally **stacks Speed Force to greatly boost his Attack** and **excels at breaking through shields**. With 3 or more [Teen Titans] allies present, he gains even more Speed Force, making him a top-tier **scaling single-target physical burst attacker**.

legacyPieces.name: Speed Metal Suit
legacyPieces.reason: Wally's signature gear. Periodically grants extra Attack and Spiritual Defense. Also increases Ultimate damage against shielded enemies. Each stack of Speed Force gained additionally increases Physical Penetration.

legacyPieces.name: T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to grant extra Physical Penetration. As a single-target physical burst attacker, Wally relies on stacking Speed Force and crits. The Speed Metal Suit enhances both his Ultimate and basic attack burst potential.

legacyPieces.name: Cold Gun
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Wally's attacks and skills land reliably. Ideal for his Ultimate and stacking Speed Force.

legacyPieces.name: Lawton Rifle Scope
legacyPieces.reason: Provides steady Attack and Crit Rate bonuses, ensuring consistent, reliable damage before Wally fully stacks his Speed Force.
